text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ⚠️ detected in continuous-batcher (us-west-2) — p99 latency spiking >3s, several containers crashed with SIGILL, node flaps observed on gpu01,gpu03. Auto-escalation to #incidents and paging eng-oncall.

sara (eng-oncall): Oncall here. I'm seeing batch_accumulator growth and repeated 'cuda: illegal instruction' errors + some OOM-like terminations. Kicking off containment now: disabling continuous batching, draining gpu01, and scaling out a couple of nodes.

javier (eng-runtime): Pasted tail of gpu01 runtime logs — lots of repeated failures:
```
[2026-03-14T22:41:02Z] batch_accum: queue_size=9800
[2026-03-14T22:41:03Z] kernel_select: selected fused-fastrun-v2
[2026-03-14T22:41:03Z] cuda: illegal instruction @ /opt/runtime/kernel.cu:412
[2026-03-14T22:41:03Z] runtime: aborting worker thread (signal SIGILL)
[2026-03-14T22:41:04Z] batch_accum: queue_size=10012
[2026-03-14T22:41:05Z] terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

mike (eng-sre): I'm draining gpu01 and gpu03 now, cordon + evict. Increasing reserved pool by +2 nodes temporarily. Notifying autoscaler to hold off until we stabilize.

sara (eng-oncall): Disabling continuous batching flag in control plane (doing a soft kill so existing inflight completes).
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal.redwood/api/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"feature":"continuous_batching","state":"off","reason":"incident: sigill+queue-growth"}'
```

kai (eng-oncall): Confirmed — control-plane returned 200. Feature flag is off. Starting rolling restart of runtime on affected nodes (graceful).

liz (eng-runtime): Heads up — we merged a kernel selection change yesterday (fused-fastrun-v2) that landed on canary -> prod. Logs line up with an illegal instruction inside that kernel. Reverting kernel selector to 'legacy-kernel' for gpu family 80.

javier (eng-runtime): Pushed kernel selection rollback to the runtime config group 'cb-v2' (routes to gpu01,gpu03). Watchers: telemetry should show p95/p99 falling as batching is disabled + legacy kernel in place.

elaine (support): FYI we already have 3 enterprise customers reporting timeouts and one automated job failed CI. CS is sending an incident advisory and asking for ETA. We should confirm scope/mitigation for customers (workarounds: retry with smaller concurrency or use dedicated route).

sara (eng-oncall): ETA for rollback + restarts ~12m. I'll stay on until it's stable, then hand off to liz for the wrap/postmortem. Marking incident as mitigating.

devops-bot: monitoring update — p95 latency dropped from 2.8s -> 0.6s, error rate down 82% after feature-flag off and node restarts.

sara (eng-oncall): Nice. Please add any logs/traces to the incident ticket. I'll open a postmortem ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-sre.

liz (eng-runtime): Taking over for next shift. I'll coordinate a deeper rollback of the fused kernel change and run the reproducer on a staging GPU farm before re-enabling. Please escalate if you see more SIGILLs.

incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigating -> partial_resolved.

sara (eng-oncall): Good job team — handoff complete to liz. I'll file the customer-impact summary and timeline after shift. :thumbsup:
